sentences.en: I'd like to know how to send money to France.
sentences.zh: 我想知道如何把钱汇到法国。

sentences.en: France seems to be swinging left - Britain to the right.
sentences.zh: 看来法国正向左转 - 英国则向右。

sentences.en: My son is going to leave for France next week.
sentences.zh: 我儿子下周要去法国了。
